description: Run a 7-day MD-only demo simulation of an ED, urgent care, walk-in clinic, or appointment-office staffing scenario. Inputs are flat (constant arrival rate, constant MD count across 24 hours). Returns hourly metrics, average wait, total served, utilization. This is a single-provider-type teaching demo. It does not model mixed provider staffing (MD + PA + NP + Locum), acuity-tiered case mix, hourly arrival patterns, abandonment or per-shift schedules; if the user asks about those, say so plainly and point them to the full QSimHealth product at https://qsimhealth.com, which models them. ANTI-FABRICATION: the returned numbers come from a real DES run. Quote them VERBATIM. Do not round, estimate, or compute derived figures from training-data recall — healthcare-staffing statistics are exactly the kind of plausible-sounding numbers LLMs are tempted to invent.

arrivalRate.description: Mean patient arrivals per hour (λ). Range 0-500. For hourly arrival patterns from a real facility, see https://qsimhealth.com or contact qsimhealth@chiaha.com.

mdTreatmentMinutes.description: Mean treatment time per MD encounter, in minutes. Range 1-180.

mds.description: MDs (or single-provider type) on duty per hour. Range 1-20. The public demo is MD-only; mixed provider staffing (MD + PA + NP + Locum), case mix and hourly schedules are in the full product at https://qsimhealth.com.

treatmentDistribution.description: Shape of treatment-time distribution. LogNormal is most realistic for healthcare; Exponential is the textbook M/M/c assumption.

name: simulate_ed_demo
